description.value: A simple contact management tool for small businesses, positioned as 'More than a spreadsheet, less than a CRM.'
A simple CRM aimed at small businesses, with contacts, leads, notes, calendar, and to-dos in one web app.

product_description.value: Contacts with full history, follow-up reminders, a daily email listing what is due, calendar sync with Google and Outlook, email logging, team sharing, and integrations with Zapier, Mailchimp, and a public API.
Sends an email every morning with everything due that day; contact tracking, tasks, calendar sync, and email logging.
Contacts, leads, notes, calendar, and to-dos; collaboration on clients, interaction notes, email logging, custom fields and pipelines.

business_model_description.value: Single tier at $15 per user per month, with no contracts, onboarding fees, or upgrade fees; free trials require no credit card.
Per-seat subscription at $15 per user per month (TrustRadius), with no long-term contracts and a first 30 days free before payment information is requested.

customer_description.value: Solo users and small businesses; the company says it avoids enterprise-focused features. The page claims more than 10,000 small businesses use the product.
Small businesses; the page claims 10,000+ small businesses have chosen the product.
Small businesses that find larger CRMs too complicated.
